header: What customers post about Larkmoor Depot
lead: Posts from the trade forum and the user group channel, shown as written and with each writer's permission.
note: Nothing here is embedded. We store the text, so no other company's script loads on this page, and the posts stay if the forum closes.

posts.quote_text: Two years in. What I didn't expect: I stopped keeping a private spreadsheet. That is my whole review.
